changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment a SET organization_id = o.id FROM organization o WHERE a.entity_id = o.id AND a.entity_type IN ('ORGANIZATION', 'ORGANIZATION_LOGO') AND a.organization_id IS NULL

changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment a SET organization_id = p.organization_id FROM project p WHERE a.entity_id = p.id AND a.entity_type IN ('PROJECT', 'PROJECT_ATTACHMENTS') AND a.organization_id IS NULL AND p.organization_id IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment a SET organization_id = t.organization_id FROM task t WHERE a.entity_id = t.id AND a.entity_type IN ('TASK', 'TASK_ATTACHMENTS') AND a.organization_id IS NULL AND t.organization_id IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment a SET organization_id = i.organization_id FROM issue i WHERE a.entity_id = i.id AND a.entity_type IN ('ISSUE', 'ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS') AND a.organization_id IS NULL AND i.organization_id IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment a SET organization_id = u.default_organization_id FROM users_table u WHERE a.entity_id = u.id AND a.entity_type IN ('USER_PROFILE_PICTURE', 'USER_CV', 'USER') AND a.organization_id IS NULL AND u.default_organization_id IS NOT NULL
